definitions.explanation: Strong encouragement or rallying of someone to keep going or try harder. Stronger and more forceful than simple 応援.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{激励|げきれい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{激励|げきれい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{奮起|ふんき}した→奮起する：21759_funkisuru⟧。
examples.english: The team was fired up by the coach's encouragement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れ→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧、⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧たち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{激励|げきれい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{回|まわ}った→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
examples.english: The company president visited the work sites and went around encouraging the employees.

notes:
{激励|げきれい} is a forceful, spirited form of encouragement — stronger than casual cheering. It implies rallying someone to try harder or keep going, typically from a person in a position of authority.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pattern: [person]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{激励|げきれい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {激励|げきれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧: words of encouragement
- {激励|げきれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive encouragement
- {激励|げきれい}⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧: pep rally, encouragement gathering
- {激励|げきれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆|か}けつける→駆けつける：14632_kaketsukeru⟧: to rush over to encourage someone

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{応援|おうえん}→応援：01900_ouen⟧: general support/cheering (broader, lighter)
- ⟦{励|はげ}まし→励ます：05304_hagemasu⟧: gentle encouragement (softer, more personal)
- ⟦{鼓舞|こぶ}→鼓舞：14713_kobu⟧: inspiring/rousing (more literary)

REGISTER:
Slightly formal. Common in news reports, sports coverage, and business contexts. Less common in casual daily conversation, where ⟦{励|はげ}ます→励ます：05304_hagemasu⟧ or ⟦{応援|おうえん}する→応援する：21988_ouensuru⟧ is preferred.
